facts.text: I am trying to get a better handle on my spending habits.
I want help tracking my expenses.

I like the idea of setting a "treat yourself" budget.
I want to determine how much to allocate for my "treat yourself" budget.
I want to know whether leftover money from my "treat yourself" budget at the end of the month can be rolled over to the next month.
